name: litellm-council
description: Cross-model council via your self-hosted LiteLLM proxy (curl+jq, no MCP, no local process). Commands: /litellm-council:second-opinion (review the current diff), :ask (any question), :debate (two rounds where models see each other's answers), :setup (save config once). Nothing hardcoded - reads LITELLM_BASE_URL / LITELLM_API_KEY / LITELLM_COUNCIL_MODELS from the environment or the setup file.
